Ranji Trophy LIVE score today: Sai Kishore strikes for TN, Priyansh Arya departs for 39; Round 3 Day 1 updates
 Follow Sportstar's live coverage of Ranji Trophy 2026-27 Round 3 Day 1 from October 26. Get the latest scores, wickets, results and highlights from all the matches.
 Updated : Oct 26, 2026 11:00 IST 
 Siddanth Nair 
 Comments

 Tamil Nadu has struck four times to leave Railways in all kinds of trouble.

 JOTHI RAMALINGAM B
 Tamil Nadu has struck four times to leave Railways in all kinds of trouble. 
 | Photo Credit: 
 JOTHI RAMALINGAM B
 T he Ranji Trophy 2026-27 round three begins on Monday, October 26, with 19 matches scheduled to take place. Defending champion Jammu and Kashmir takes on Baroda, while Sai Kishore’s Tamil Nadu will take on Railways. Follow Sportstar for live scores, wickets, match updates and results from across the country.
 October 26, 2026 11:00 
 Anirudh pings from Secunderabad
 Harnoor Brar (17, 49b) falls in the third over after drinks. He tries to attack the gap with a sweep but doesn’t get the right connection. Top edge and the ball sails pretty high, giving wicketkeeper Pragnay Reddy time to position himself for a pretty easy catch. Tanay Thyagarajann breaks the 48-run stand and gets his first wicket of the match.
 Punjab 62/2 after 22.1 overs.
 October 26, 2026 10:55 
 Sankar pings from Chepauk, basically a one-arm distance from where I am sitting 
 Railways loses half its wickets. Vivek comes down the track against Sai Kishore, only to be caught at cover. The southpaw will be disappointed with the shot, given his team’s dire situation. No complaints from Sai Kishore’s men, who have Railways reeling at 33/5 in 15 overs
 October 26, 2026 10:45 
 Andhra loses three wickets, Sahil with the latest updates
 Dharmendrasinh Jadeja strikes. Karan Shinde is caught at leg slip. Turns the ball into the left hander which takes a faint edge off the bat. Andhra 59/3.
 October 26, 2026 10:43 
 Trouble, trouble, trouble, and more trouble for Goa 
 Rajneesh Gurbani comes on first over after the drinks break and strikes straight away! Goes fuller and lures Manthan into the striaght drive, it pings straight off the middle but the veteran seamer is alert to take a brilliant reflex catch. 
 Snehal Kauthankar joins Abhinav Tejrana at the crease, Goa 34/3.
 October 26, 2026 10:34 
 Shaik Rasheed holding steady for Andhra, says Sahil
 Shaik Rasheed has looked quite assured through this initial phase of the innings. A couple of lovely drives as well — playing with the turn. Has to play a long innings to get Andhra to a competitive position given how much the ball has already turned inside the first hour.
 October 26, 2026 10:32 
 Tripura openers frustrate Karnataka
 Karnataka bring on spinner Ritesh in the seventh over. The offspinner immediately gets some grip and turn, but the Tripura openers stay compact. 
 Karnataka desperately missing Kaverappa, who could have made an impact with the new ball. No official confirmation yet on why Kaverappa is not playing.
 October 26, 2026 10:31 
 Priyansh Arya departs for 39!!
 Kounain Quraishi has castled Priyansh Arya with a beauty. Pitched on middle and hit off stump. Priyansh’s defence breached. Delhi 56/1 in 18.2 overs.
 October 26, 2026 10:27 
 More misery for Railways courtesy R Sai Kishore
 Sai Kishore clean bowls Raj Choudhary to leave Railways reeling at 18/4. 
 October 26, 2026 10:22 
 Aditya pings from Nagpur
 Nachiket Bhute can probably count himself a little unlucky not to have another wicket this morning. 
 He’s had a couple of LBW shouts turned down, and found the outside edge short of the slips but no joy yet. Yash Thakur, on the other hand, has started a little too short and allowed Abhinav Tejrana and Manthan Khutkar to leave.
 October 26, 2026 10:21 
 Amol pings from Mumbai
 Play in the V, they say, when it comes to facing red-ball early on. Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Musheer Khan seem to remember the childhood lesson to perfection. Not only have they played straight but punched and driven to perfection whenever the Haryana seamers have pitched it full. Both of Musheer’s fours have come straight down, with Raghuvanshi - who was cautious for the first 40 minutes - joining in with a striaght drive. 21/1 in 8.
 October 26, 2026 10:18 
 Sahil pings from Mulapadu
 A lovely loop from Mandal, inviting Abhishek Reddy to come down the track. The right hander obliges but ends up swinging the bat for nothing as the ball turns away just in front of him and the keeper completes the stumping.
 October 26, 2026 10:15 
 Start of Kerala Bengal delayed
 The second inspection will be at 10.30 am, says Praveen Chandran. 
 October 26, 2026 10:12 
 Delhi brings 50-run opening stand!!!
 Priyansh Arya has deposited offie Aditya Singh over long-off for a six. Brings up the 50-run opening partnership for Delhi.
 October 26, 2026 10:09 
 Vihaan dismissed cheaply!! 
 Rakshann Readdi gives Hyderabad the breakthrough! Vihaan Malhotra (12, 20b, 2x4) falls, Ruthik Yadav taking a good catch at deep fine leg. Punjab 14/1 after 5.1 overs. Prabhsimran Singh the new batter.
 October 26, 2026 10:04 
 Sahil pings from Malapadu
 Abhishek Reddy showing a sense of urgency for some reason. Has been trying to convince Rasheed for quick singles but his partner hasn’t budged. Reddy eventually gets a half volley which he drives straight back past the bowler for four to calm him down. 
 Meanwhile, Sandeep Warrier and Chhattisgarh don’t think there’s much movement on offer and have kept a deep extra cover from the beginning.
 October 26, 2026 10:01 
 Sonu Yadav right now 
 storm johnny GIF - Find & Share on GIPHY
 Discover & share this storm johnny GIF with everyone you know. GIPHY is how you search, share, discover, and create GIFs.
 October 26, 2026 10:00 
 Sonu on fire 🔥
 The fast bowler is too hot to handle at the moment, hes already picked up three wickets for three runs!! Railways reeling at 7/3. 
 October 26, 2026 09:56 
 Anirudh pings from Secunderabad
 Hyderabad begin the day with four overs of pace, from C.V. Milind and Rakshann Readdi. In the fifth over, spin comes into play, with Ruthik Yadav taking the ball.
 Punjab 13/0 after 4 overs.
 October 26, 2026 09:53 
 Terrible start to the day for Goa, says Aditya
 Saving the best for the last I guess but Aditya Padinjat finally joins the party with an update. Vidarbha won ths toss and opted to bowl first, and both openers are back in the shed inside the first two overs. Harsh Dubey struck to dismiss Shivendra Bhujbal in the first over before Nachiket Bhute removed Suyash Prabhudessai.
 October 26, 2026 09:51 
 Son Yadav strikes for TN! 
 Early breakthrough for TN as Sonu Yadav gets the outside edge of Sahab Singh before Baba Indrajith completes a good catch at second slip. 
 October 26, 2026 09:47 
 Haryana makes early inroads against Mumbai
 Aman Kumar strikes in the third over. Jags one back into Divyaansh Saxena and he misses the drive to be adujudged lbw. 12/1.
 October 26, 2026 09:46 
 Bihar rocked early against Madhya Pradesh 
 Avesh Khan gets in on the act early, strikes twice to leave Bihar two down. 
 October 26, 2026 09:43 
 Same shots, different outcomes- Sahil 'Shakespeare' Mathur
 Dev Aditya Singh strikes off his first delivery, gets Hemanth Reddy caught slashing straight to point. 
 No.3 Shaik Rasheed attempts a similar shot off his first ball and sends the ball for four!
 October 26, 2026 09:34 
 Ashwin pings from Mysuru! 
 Karnataka includes three spinners - Shreyas Gopal, Ritesh Bhatkal and Shikhar Shetty - in the eleven against Tripura at Mysuru. Pacers Kaverappa, Abhilash Shetty out. Despite heavy cloud cover, Mysuru pitch expected to assist spinners, especially late in the game.
 October 26, 2026 09:24 
 Sahil pings from Mulapadu!!
 After a chaotic build up to the game where the venue was shifted from Raipur to Mulapadu last minute, the teams are here on a bright Monday morning. 
 Host Andhra has won the toss and elected to bat. The side is playing with only one pacer in KV Sasikanth.
 October 26, 2026 09:20 
 Punjab opts to bat, Tamil Nadu opts to bowl
 Punjab will bat first against Hyderabad, Tamil Nadu opts to bowl against Railways. 
 October 26, 2026 09:17 
 Some of the big names who will be in action
 Bengal- Mohammed Shami
 Tamil Nadu- Sai Kishore
 Saurashtra- Ravindra Jadeja
 Delhi- Priyansh Arya
 Punjab- Prabhsimran Singh
 October 26, 2026 09:09 
 Amol pings from Mumbai! 
 It’s toss time at the Sharad Pawar Academy ground. Mumbai vs Haryana. Siddhesh Lad proudly wearing the Mumbai blazer for the third time in as many weeks. Ankit Kumar calls it right and elects to field. WhatsApp Image 2026-10-26 at 09.06.57.jpeg
 October 26, 2026 09:03 
 Chennai weather right now
 If you are wondering why Sankar said ‘hopefully’ for the toss to begin as scheduled, its because Chennai is like the gif below, with rain in the air. Can’t believe we are here after what seemed like endless months of relentess heat and humidity, almost brings tears to my eyes 🥹

 October 26, 2026 09:00 
 Sankar pings from Chepauk! 
 Good morning from a rather overcast Chepauk.
 It’s Pitch No. 6 — a mix-soil surface — for today’s Group D clash between Tamil Nadu and Railways.
 The pitch was under covers for most of yesterday due to rain, with head coaches Yo Mahesh and Syed Zakaria Zuffri saying their teams didn’t get a proper look at it. 
 Toss soon (hopefully) WhatsApp Image 2026-10-26 at 08.52.13.jpeg
 October 26, 2026 09:00 
 Who would win in a rubgy match between Hyderabad and Punjab? 
 As we wait for the toss, a sidequestion to keep ourselves occupied- who do you think would win a rugby match between Hyderabad and Punjab? Both sides have players with serious potential. For Hyderabad, there’s Mohammed Siraj, the fiery customer.
 And for Punjab, good luck getting past Gurnoor, who its safe to say would probably be rock solid in defence. Anways, thats enough of rugby, lets get back into cricket. 
 October 26, 2026 08:57 
 Hyderabad and Punjab go rugby mode 
 WhatsApp Image 2026-10-26 at 08.41.09.jpeg
 October 26, 2026 08:55 
 Anirudh pings from Secunderabad! 
 Our first update of the day is from Anirudh Velamuri from Hyderabad aaaaanndddd its an interesting one......
 Hyderabad and Punjab are seen practising a version of American football (or rugby) during pre-match training. Very interesting indeed. 
 October 26, 2026 08:53 
 Who will face who in Round 3? 
 Delhi vs Jharkhand- Delhi won the toss and chose to bat (Vivek Krishnan on the ground)
 Odisha vs Services- Services won the toss and chose to field
 Andhra vs Chattisgarh (Sahil Mathur on the ground)
 Baroda vs Jammu and Kashmir
 Chandigarh vs Himachal Pradesh
 Hyderabad vs Punjab (Anirudh Velamuri on the ground)
 Karnataka vs Tripura (Ashwin Achal on the ground)
 Kerala vs Bengal (Praveen Chandran on the ground)
 Madhya Pradesh vs Bihar
 Maharashtra vs Gujarat
 Manipur vs Arunachal Pradesh (plate)
 Mizoram vs Meghalaya (plate)
 Mumbai vs Haryana (Amol Karhadkar on the ground)
 Pondicherry vs Uttar Pradesh
 Saurashtra vs Assam
 Tamil Nadu vs Railways (Sankar Narayanan on the ground)
 Uttarakhand vs Rajasthan
 Vidarbha vs Goa (Aditya Padinjat on the ground)
 October 26, 2026 08:45 
 Good morning! 
 Good morning and welcome back viewers!!!!!! Hows the josh?!!! We are back for more Ranji Trophy action. Round 3, Day 1 will see nineteen matches taking place with eight of our reporters on the ground.
 I am Siddanth Nair , and I will be taking you through all the live updates from the length and breadth of the country. So sit back, relax, and enjoy the ride, because I got you covered. Here we go.
